positions.title: Information Security Intern
positions.description: Skills: Java · Interpersonal Communication · Technical Documentation · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Blockchain Security Intern
positions.description:
- Assisted in developing a software tool that performed static analysis upon smart contracts to search for insecure code patterns.
- Successfully delivered 4 new checks to the tool, and expanded several other checks.
- Successfully helped deliver a complete overhaul of the tool, assisted in design, implementation, and testing.
- Wrote numerous unit tests for each check the tool supported.
- Designed and presented the schema for the storage of certain data in the upgraded tool.
- Developed the testing framework for a particular module of the upgraded tool.
- Wrote two technical documents to assist future developers in writing additional checks for the upgraded tool.
- Developed a preliminary design for a script to assist developers in creating a human-readable abstraction of the data within the tool.
